intended_object: The one-point topological space (the terminal object of Top), as an object of `TopCat` in any universe. This comes from the docstring.
explanation: The definition is `TopCat.of (ULift PUnit)`. `ULift PUnit` has exactly one element, and the lifted topology on it is the only possible one, so this is the one-point space. Lifting it to an arbitrary universe `v` is the usual way to put it in any universe, which is what the docstring promises. Mathlib has no named definition for this space; it uses `TopCat.of PUnit.{u+1}` inline, for example in `TopCat.isTerminalPUnit`, which is the same object. A specific space cannot be too narrow, so the definition is faithful.
